notes: Added #include <functional> for std::function support in lambda.
Implemented explicit vendor selection logic for NVIDIA (0x10DE) and AMD (0x1002) physical devices.
Corrected buffer barriers: Added src/dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED to all VkBufferMemoryBarriers.
Fixed pipeline stages in barriers: Used TRANSFER->TRANSFER for internal copies and TRANSFER->HOST or HOST->TRANSFER for host interactions.
Ensured B upload uses memcpy of real bytes into mapped host memory before GPU transfer.
Verified full parity check against original PATTERN across all 65536 words.
Implemented --inject-corruption flag that mutates B_host before GPU transfer, causing mismatch detection on readback.
Added bounded 10-second timeout loop for vkWaitForFences returning exit code 3 on timeout.
Preserved RAII-style cleanup order and error handling for all Vulkan objects.
